scope: D3D9 Reset mode/style/foreground transitions using the existing fullscreen policy, with scoped ANSI/Unicode WM_SIZE filtering and procedure restoration. Unsupported physical mode and desktop-restore failures keep NOTRESET; the host Reset may already be queued before physical mode failure. D3D8 mode integration, adapter-vs-backbuffer GetDisplayMode query correction, exact focus-window policy, fullscreen refresh/bit-depth normalization, all CreateDevice validation, physical focus/device loss, concurrent subclass changes, native Microsoft HAL and game/FPS acceptance remain outside this step.

documentation.fact: CDS_FULLSCREEN is temporary; NULL with flags zero restores the registry mode; unsupported modes return failure.

facts.nativeTest: d3d9-device-tests.c test_reset_fullscreen, lines 4808 onward: window-to-fullscreen and fullscreen resize, suppress WM_SIZE recursion
